_about: SECOND held-out set for policy retrieval. FROZEN: its SHA-256 is in retrieval_heldout2.sha256 and eval_heldout.py --set 2 refuses to run if the file changed. Never use it to tune anything. The questions were written by a language model that was NOT shown the policies, and each was labelled against the policy passages by two other models; a question is kept only if both agreed. This is more independent than the first held-out set, but it is not human-written and not real users' questions. See evaluation/retrieval2/PROTOCOL.md.
